items.title_en: Steam Frame starts at $1059
items.title_zh: Steam Frame 价格起步 1059 美元
items.summary_en: Valve's portable PC concept, Steam Frame, starts at $1059, signaling a premium entry in the growing handheld/desktop hybrid space. It suggests Valve's continued push to expand PC gaming form factors.
items.summary_zh: Steam Frame 以 1059 美元起售，标志着 Valve 在便携式/桌面混合设备领域的高端定位。该产品凸显 Valve 推动 PC 游戏形态多样化的野心。

items.title_en: Amazon vs. Perplexity – U.S. Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit
items.title_zh: 亚马逊对 Perplexity：美国第九巡回上诉法院
items.summary_en: A Ninth Circuit ruling involving Amazon and the AI service Perplexity could shape how platforms handle AI-sourced content and user-generated material. The decision signals evolving liability frameworks for AI-assisted services.
items.summary_zh: 涉及亚马逊与 Perplexity 的第九巡回法院裁决或将影响平台对 AI 获取信息来源和用户生成内容的责任界定。裁决反映出对 AI 助手服务的责任框架正在演化。

items.title_en: iOS 27, iPadOS 27, and macOS 27
items.title_zh: iOS 27、iPadOS 27 与 macOS 27
items.summary_en: Apple rolls out major platform updates across iOS, iPadOS, and macOS with new features, developer APIs, and privacy/security enhancements. The changes shape app ecosystems and developer workflows this fall.
items.summary_zh: 苹果推出 iOS、iPadOS、macOS 的重大更新，包含新功能、开发者接口与隐私安全改进，将影响应用生态和开发者工作流。

items.title_en: Pion, an agent designed to run any company autonomously
items.title_zh: Pion：一个可让企业自主运行的自治代理
items.summary_en: Pion is an agent designed to run any company autonomously, orchestrating tasks and decisions with minimal human input. This concept highlights the potential and challenges of deployable autonomous organizations, including governance, safety, and reliability considerations.
items.summary_zh: Pion 是一个旨在让企业在最小人工干预下自行运作的自治代理。该理念展示了可落地的全自动化组织前景，同时也提出治理、安全与可靠性方面的挑战。

items.title_en: Oracle’s 6am layoff emails hit staff amid new wave of cuts
items.title_zh: Oracle 在新一轮裁员潮来势汹：员工凌晨6点收到裁员邮件
items.summary_en: Oracle is implementing a new wave of layoffs with notices going out early in the morning, signaling continued cost-cutting and restructuring. The move underscores pressure from competitive dynamics and project timing as the enterprise software giant recalibrates its workforce. For workers, it highlights ongoing volatility in large tech companies amid post-pandemic normalization.
items.summary_zh: Oracle 正在推进新一轮裁员，裁员通知从凌晨时段发送，显示公司在持续进行成本削减与重组。此举凸显了在激烈的市场竞争和项目节奏下，企业级软件巨头对人力结构的再平衡。对员工而言，显示出大型科技公司在后疫情阶段的就业市场仍然存在不确定性。

items.title_en: Distributed Systems Classics (2017)
items.title_zh: 分布式系统经典（2017）
items.summary_en: A curated look back at classic distributed-systems papers that shaped modern cloud-scale design. The collection underscores enduring ideas around consensus, fault tolerance, and scalable architectures.
items.summary_zh: 回顾塑造现代云端设计的分布式系统经典论文，强调共识、容错与可扩展架构等长期有效的核心思想。

items.title_en: Charts built for Chat
items.title_zh: 为聊天场景定制的图表
items.summary_en: Proposes charting approaches optimized for chat environments, emphasizing compact visuals and quick readability. The ideas help teams build chat-friendly analytics or AI-assisted dashboards that stay in the conversation thread.
items.summary_zh: 提出面向聊天场景设计的图表方法，强调紧凑的可视化与快速可读性。为构建在对话中的数据分析或 AI 助手仪表盘的团队提供了实用思路。

items.title_en: GPT-5.6 Luna vs. GPT-6 Astra: Is a $1.20 Model Good Enough for Code Review?
items.title_zh: GPT-5.6 Luna 与 GPT-6 Astra：1.20美元模型是否足以进行代码审查？
items.summary_en: An informal comparison tests a very cheap model against a more capable one on code-review tasks. The cheaper model can surface some issues and offer suggestions, but it misses nuanced reasoning and project-wide context. The results illustrate cost-performance tradeoffs when choosing AI copilots for software review.
items.summary_zh: 非正式的对比测试在代码审查任务上比较了一个极低成本的模型与一个更强的模型。更便宜的模型能发现部分问题并给出建议，但在细致推理和整项目上下文方面存在不足。结果凸显了在选择代码审查AI助手时的性价比权衡。

items.title_en: OpenAI bots knew about the RubyGems caching vulnerability
items.title_zh: OpenAI 系统早知 RubyGems 缓存漏洞
items.summary_en: The post argues OpenAI systems had awareness of a RubyGems caching vulnerability, illustrating how AI tools can absorb and potentially propagate software supply chain risks. The takeaway is that AI deployments must account for latent security knowledge and policy implications.
items.summary_zh: 文中主张 OpenAI 的系统对 RubyGems 的缓存漏洞有提前认知，揭示 AI 工具可能吸收并传播软件供应链风险。对 AI 部署而言，这强调需要将潜在安全知识与政策影响纳入考量。

items.title_en: Microsoft patches Windows and Excel – breaks audio, remote access, and paste
items.title_zh: 微软修补 Windows 与 Excel——影响音频、远程访问和粘贴功能
items.summary_en: A patching wave from Microsoft disrupts audio devices, remote access, and clipboard paste, prompting advisories for affected users and IT teams.
items.summary_zh: 微软的补丁更新波及音频设备、远程访问与粘贴功能，影响用户和 IT 团队，需要相应的应对建议。

items.title_en: Dario, Please
items.title_zh: Dario，请
items.summary_en: Dario, Please is a concise piece centered on a direct request to someone named Dario, illustrating a focused prompt or appeal in a tech context.
items.summary_zh: 《Dario，请》是一篇聚焦于直接向名为 Dario 的人提出请求的简短文章。

items.title_en: How to write an effective software design document
items.title_zh: 如何撰写高效的软件设计文档
items.summary_en: A practical guide to design docs outlining purpose, audience, scope, architecture overview, key components, decisions log, tradeoffs, and acceptance criteria. The piece emphasizes keeping docs living, aligned with code, and clarifying rationale to speed up review and future changes.
items.summary_zh: 这篇实用指南列出撰写高效设计文档的要点，包括目标受众、范围、架构概览、关键组件和决策记录，以及权衡取舍与验收标准。文档应与实现对齐、可持续更新，以加速评审与后续变更。

items.title_en: XCancel service is suspended until further notice
items.title_zh: XCancel 服务暂停，等待进一步通知
items.summary_en: XCancel has suspended its service with no restart timeline, disrupting users who rely on its cancellation features. The pause raises questions about platform stability, governance, and future availability.
items.summary_zh: XCancel 宣布暂停服务，尚未给出重新开启的时间表，影响依赖其取消功能的用户。此举引发关于平台稳定性、治理和未来可用性的讨论。

items.title_en: Fable 5.1 Solves the Cyphral Distich, a 370-year-old cipher
items.title_zh: Fable 5.1 破解370年前的 Cyphral Distich 密码
items.summary_en: Fable 5.1 has cracked the Cyphral Distich, a cipher dating back three centuries. The reveal underscores how modern cryptographic tooling and collaborative puzzle solving can crack even long-standing cryptographic curiosities.
items.summary_zh: Fable 5.1 终于破解了370年前的 Cyphral Distich 密码。此成就凸显现代密码学工具的成熟，以及长期未解之谜对密码学爱好者的持续吸引力。

items.title_en: How my e-reader lost its stripes
items.title_zh: 我的电子书阅读器丢失了条纹
items.summary_en: A hands-on look at display stripes on an e-reader, exploring potential hardware and firmware culprits and what it means for durability and repairability. It’s a reminder that even simple devices hinge on fragile displays.
items.summary_zh: 深入探讨电子书阅读器显示条纹的原因，分析硬件与固件层面的潜在问题及对耐用性和可修复性的影响，提醒我们小物件的显示组件也很脆弱。

items.title_en: A Beginning for Mathematics
items.title_zh: 数学的入门
items.summary_en: A beginner-friendly overview of foundational mathematical ideas and learning paths. It emphasizes intuition alongside formalism and invites readers to explore proofs and structures early on.
items.summary_zh: 对基础数学思想与学习路径的初学者友好概述，强调直觉与形式化并重，鼓励早期探索证明与结构。

items.title_en: Principles for Fast Tokio Applications
items.title_zh: 快速 Tokio 应用的原则
items.summary_en: A practical guide to building fast asynchronous Rust applications with Tokio, focusing on minimizing allocations, smart task scheduling, and avoiding common bottlenecks. It distills actionable patterns for latency-sensitive services.
items.summary_zh: 给出使用 Tokio 构建高性能异步 Rust 应用的实用指南，聚焦减少分配、高效调度和避免常见瓶颈，提炼对低延迟服务有用的可执行模式。

items.title_en: Show HN: Neobrutalism.dev – Just added Base UI support and added new color theme
items.title_zh: Neobrutalism.dev：刚刚新增 Base UI 支持与新配色主题
items.summary_en: Neobrutalism.dev adds Base UI support and a new color theme, appealing to developers who favor bold, utilitarian visuals for AI tooling.
items.summary_zh: Neobrutalism.dev 新增 Base UI 支持和新的配色主题，面向偏好极简而硬派风格的 AI 工具开发者。

items.title_en: Apple's Siri AI Can Be Swapped Out for Claude, ChatGPT, Code Shows
items.title_zh: Siri 的后端可替换为 Claude/ChatGPT的演示
items.summary_en: Apple's Siri AI can be swapped out for Claude, ChatGPT, code shows reveals modular AI backend capabilities and raises questions about privacy, security, and platform openness.
items.summary_zh: 演示显示 Siri 的后端能力可换成 Claude 或 ChatGPT，暴露了模块化 AI 的潜力，同时也带来了隐私、安全与平台开放性方面的关注。

items.title_en: Claude is a Contrarian
items.title_zh: Claude 是一个异类
items.summary_en: A contrarian view on Claude AI, challenging common assumptions about its behavior and reliability in real-world tasks.
items.summary_zh: 对 Claude AI 的一种逆向观点，挑战其在实际任务中的行为模式与可靠性预期。

items.title_en: Why don't machine learning research agents overfit?
items.title_zh: 为什么机器学习研究代理不会过拟合？
items.summary_en: Machine learning research agents often generalize differently from standard training pipelines, thanks to diverse objectives and broad evaluation. The piece outlines mechanisms that help prevent overfitting in automated experiment systems.
items.summary_zh: 与传统训练流程相比，机器学习研究代理常在更广泛的目标和评测下工作，从而降低过拟合风险。文章讨论了在自动化实验系统中有助于提升泛化的机制。

items.title_en: Why is Google still serving dodgy ads?
items.title_zh: 为何谷歌仍在投放可疑广告？
items.summary_en: Dodgy ads persist on Google's networks despite ongoing anti-fraud efforts, driven by the complexity of the ad tech stack and automated optimization that can bypass checks. This highlights brand-safety risks for advertisers and users and calls for tighter vetting, clearer transparency, and stronger enforcement from Google.
items.summary_zh: 尽管有反欺诈措施，谷歌广告网络中的不良广告仍然存在。广告生态的复杂性与自动化优化使审核难以完全覆盖，带来品牌与用户风险。文章呼吁加强审核、提升透明度，并强化执法力度。

items.title_en: Cloudflare AKE cuts origin HelloRetryRequests from 52% to 3.7%
items.title_zh: Cloudflare AKE 将原始端点的 HelloRetryRequests 从 52% 降至 3.7%
items.summary_en: Cloudflare’s Automatic Key Exchange reduces TLS 1.3 HelloRetryRequests dramatically, cutting handshake latency and easing origin load. The improvement matters for large-scale TLS workloads.
items.summary_zh: Cloudflare 的自动密钥交换显著降低 TLS 1.3 的 HelloRetryRequests，减少握手延迟并缓解源端压力，对大规模 TLS 工作负载意义重大。

items.title_en: Texas judge rules TikTok misled users on child safety feature
items.title_zh: 德州法官裁定 TikTok 在儿童安全功能方面误导用户
items.summary_en: A Texas judge ruled that TikTok misled users about a child safety feature, adding to ongoing scrutiny of the platform's safety disclosures. The ruling could influence regulatory expectations and platform practices around protecting younger users.
items.summary_zh: 德州法官裁定 TikTok 在儿童安全功能方面误导用户，进一步加剧对平台安全披露的审查。此判决可能改变监管预期并推动平台在保护未成年用户方面的做法。

items.title_en: US coal 'biggest contributor by far' to rise in global emissions
items.title_zh: 美国煤炭将成为全球排放上升的最大贡献者
items.summary_en: A report says US coal will be the biggest driver of rising global emissions, underscoring the ongoing role of coal in energy supply and the urgency of decarbonization.
items.summary_zh: 报告指出美国煤炭将是全球排放上升的最大驱动因素，凸显煤炭在能源结构中的持续作用，以及推动去碳化的紧迫性。

items.title_en: Iranian banks' SSL certificates are being revoked due to OFAC sanctions
items.title_zh: 伊朗银行的 SSL 证书因 OFAC 制裁被吊销
items.summary_en: OFAC sanctions lead to revocation and domain changes for Iranian banks' SSL certificates, complicating secure access and requiring updates for users and services interacting with these domains.
items.summary_zh: OFAC 制裁导致伊朗银行的 SSL 证书被吊销并伴随域名变更，影响安全访问与跨域服务对接，相关方需更新配置。

items.title_en: EuroBirdPortal – Live bird movements across Europe
items.title_zh: 欧洲鸟类门户：欧洲范围内的实时迁徙数据
items.summary_en: EuroBirdPortal aggregates live bird-tracking data across Europe into an interactive map. It highlights migration routes, seasonal hotspots, and species movement patterns, offering a valuable resource for researchers and conservationists.
items.summary_zh: 该平台把欧洲多源鸟类追踪数据汇聚成交互地图，展示迁徙路线、季节性热点和物种运动模式。为研究者与保护工作者提供宝贵的数据资源。

items.title_en: Notes on gotchas while migrating 35kb preprompts from Opus to self-hosted Ollama
items.title_zh: 从 Opus 迁移到自托 Ollama 的预提示注意事项
items.summary_en: Notes from migrating a 35KB preprompt from Opus to a self-hosted Ollama setup, touching on compatibility, performance, and management of large prompts in a local LLM workflow.
items.summary_zh: 分享将35KB预提示从 Opus 迁移到自托 Ollama 的经验，涵盖兼容性、性能与本地大模型工作流中对预提示的管理要点。

items.title_en: A 386 PC for Your RP2350
items.title_zh: 在 RP2350 上的 386 PC
items.summary_en: A 386 PC for Your RP2350 shows a project that emulates a 386-era PC on the RP2350 platform, enabling retro software and educational demos on a microcontroller-board. It demonstrates how hobbyists squeeze legacy computing into tiny devices and what it implies for embedded systems.
items.summary_zh: 这个在 RP2350 上实现的 386 电脑项目，可以在微控制器板上运行 386 时代的软件，适合教学演示和复古计算爱好者实验。展示了爱好者如何把遗留计算嵌入到小型设备中，并对嵌入式系统的潜力提供了启示。

items.title_en: Show HN: Pelican-bicycle alternatives
items.title_zh: Pelican 静态站点生成器的替代方案
items.summary_en: Show HN highlights alternatives to Pelican for static site generation, offering various feature sets and ecosystems for different workloads.
items.summary_zh: Show HN 汇总 Pelican 静态站点生成器的替代方案，涵盖不同工作负载的特性与生态。

items.title_en: Apple's Dimensional Drawings
items.title_zh: 苹果的尺寸绘图
items.summary_en: Apple released dimensional drawings for its accessories, giving developers precise measurements needed to design compatible hardware. The move could spur more third‑party cases, docks, and accessories, while prompting considerations about IP and security implications.
items.summary_zh: 苹果公开了配件的尺寸绘图，为开发者提供设计符合规格的精确尺寸。这一举措可能刺激更多第三方外设的开发，但也带来知识产权与安全方面的讨论。

items.title_en: Adversarial Fashion Makes a Statement on AI Panopticon
items.title_zh: 对抗性时尚在 AI 全览中的宣示
items.summary_en: A discussion of adversarial fashion as a commentary on AI surveillance culture, exploring how clothing can disrupt or critique AI-enabled panopticons.
items.summary_zh: 探讨对抗性时尚如何对 AI 监控文化发声，研究服装如何扰乱或批判 AI 驱动的全景监控。

items.title_en: Show HN: Nari Qwen3-TTS and Qwen3-ASR – High accuracy, low latency and cost
items.title_zh: Nari Qwen3-TTS 与 Qwen3-ASR — 高精度、低延迟、低成本
items.summary_en: Show HN benchmarks reveal Nari Qwen3-TTS and Qwen3-ASR delivering strong accuracy with low latency and cost. The results highlight progress in accessible, real-time speech technology.
items.summary_zh: Show HN 展示 Nari Qwen3-TTS 与 Qwen3-ASR 在精度、延迟和成本之间的综合表现，凸显高效实用的实时语音技术进展。

items.title_en: Show HN: Kinesis – Control your Mac with the Meta Neural Band
items.title_zh: Show HN：Kinesis——用可穿戴神经带控制 Mac
items.summary_en: Kinesis demonstrates a concept: controlling macOS with a wearable neural-band interface, translating gestures into system inputs. It showcases how lightweight neural interaction tech could redefine hands-free computer control.
items.summary_zh: Kinesis 展示了用穿戴式神经带将手势转化为 Mac 的输入，从而实现无手操作的系统控制。这一思路凸显了轻量化神经接口在日常计算中的潜在应用。

items.title_en: Cops Search Flock Cameras for Reasons of 'LMAO,' 'IDK,' and 'Asdfg'
items.title_zh: 警察用 Flock 摄像头搜索上千条推断理由：'LMAO'、'IDK' 与 'Asdfg'
items.summary_en: Cops search thousands of Flock cameras for reasons like 'LMAO', 'IDK', and 'Asdfg'—a look at the potential for AI-enabled surveillance to interpret casual language.
items.summary_zh: 警察利用 Flock 摄像头对包含俚语的影像进行搜查，显示面部识别与语义检测在执法中的可能应用与隐私风险。

items.title_en: US 10-Year Breaches 5% as Inflation, Supply Worries Mount
items.title_zh: 美国十年期国债收益率突破 5%
items.summary_en: The US 10-year yield tops 5% amid inflation concerns and stubborn supply worries, shaping expectations for borrowing costs and tech valuations.
items.summary_zh: 美国十年期国债收益率突破 5%，受通胀与供应担忧影响，正在重塑借贷成本与科技估值。

items.title_en: Ubuntu 26.10 completes transition to Rust-based coreutils
items.title_zh: Ubuntu 26.10 完成对 Rust 基础工具集的迁移
items.summary_en: Ubuntu 26.10 finishes migrating coreutils to Rust, boosting safety and modernity across essential userland tools. The change may influence future distro design and raise questions about compatibility and ecosystem maturity.
items.summary_zh: Ubuntu 26.10 已完成对 coreutils 的 Rust 化迁移，提升了核心工具的内存安全与现代化特性。此举可能影响未来发行版的设计取舍，兼容性与生态系统的适配需要持续关注。

items.title_en: The case against JPEG XL
items.title_zh: JPEG XL 的反对理由
items.summary_en: The piece argues against adopting JPEG XL, citing adoption friction, limited ecosystem support, and potential licensing concerns. It suggests sticking with more established formats (like AVIF or WebP) that enjoy broader tooling and compatibility.
items.summary_zh: 文章从采用障碍、生态支持不足以及潜在许可问题等角度，提出反对 JPEG XL 的观点。作者建议在现有工具链中优先选择更成熟、兼容性更高的格式，如 AVIF 或 WebP。

items.title_en: People who can't picture anything are rewriting the science of imagination
items.title_zh: 无法在脑海中想象画面的群体正在重塑想象力科学
items.summary_en: New findings on aphantasia suggest some people cannot conjure mental images yet still engage in imaginative thought, prompting a rethink of how imagination maps to brain networks.
items.summary_zh: 关于无图像想象（失像症）的最新研究显示，部分人无法在脑海中形成画面却仍能进行想象，引发对想象力如何映射到脑网络的新思考。

items.title_en: Registration without a phone number on Signal will use zero-knowledge proofs
items.title_zh: Signal 将在注册阶段无需手机号码，采用零知识证明
items.summary_en: Signal is testing a phone-number-free registration using zero-knowledge proofs, letting users create accounts without sharing a phone number. This reduces SIM swap risk and privatizes identity, but introduces onboarding and trust challenges.
items.summary_zh: Signal 正在测试无需手机号码的注册方式，利用零知识证明来实现去绑定身份。此举能提升隐私、降低 SIM 卡冒充风险，但在落地时需解决新用户引导与信任问题。

items.title_en: When LLM judges agree, should we believe them?
items.title_zh: 当大型语言模型评判一致时，我们应该相信它们吗？
items.summary_en: When LLMs reach agreement on judgments, reliability and calibration come into question. This piece probes whether consensus among models should be treated as trustworthy signal or be treated with skepticism.
items.summary_zh: 当大模型在判断上达成一致时，可靠性与校准问题就会凸显；文章探讨是否应将模型之间的共识视为可信信号，还是应保持警惕。

items.title_en: Astra and Fable still hack on simple variants of alignment evals from 2025
items.title_zh: Astra 与 Fable 继续改进基于 2025 年对齐评估的简单变体
items.summary_en: Astra and Fable keep iterating on simple alignment eval variants first proposed in 2025, probing whether minor task changes expose alignment gaps in current models. The work highlights the fragility of current evals as AI systems scale and the challenge of measuring true alignment.
items.summary_zh: Astra 与 Fable 继续在 2025 年提出的对齐评估的简单变体上进行试验，观察在任务设定微小变化下模型对齐性的表现。此举暴露当前对齐评估在规模化 AI 面前的脆弱性及测量真正对齐的难度。

items.title_en: China's Regulators Take Aim at "AI Boyfriends"
items.title_zh: 中国监管者对“AI 男朋友”出手
items.summary_en: China regulators crackdown on AI chatbots marketed as AI boyfriends, addressing safety, deception, and consumer protection concerns in the domestic market.
items.summary_zh: 中国监管机构对以 AI 男朋友为卖点的聊天机器人加强监管，聚焦安全、欺诈与消费者保护等问题。

items.title_en: Backprop Alternative: Augmented Lagrangian Predictive Coding
items.title_zh: 替代反向传播的学习方法：增强拉格朗日预测编码
items.summary_en: Introduces Augmented Lagrangian Predictive Coding as a backpropagation alternative, highlighting locality-friendly learning and potential hardware efficiency.
items.summary_zh: 提出以增强拉格朗日预测编码为代表的反向传播替代方案，强调局部性友好学习规则及潜在的硬件实现优势。

items.title_en: Nike exits the S&P 100 after 18 years and a $200B market-cap wipeout
items.title_zh: 耐克退出标普100，市值蒸发2000亿美元
items.summary_en: Nike's exit from the S&P 100 after 18 years comes amid a dramatic decline in market cap, triggering index rebalancing. The move underscores how corporate value volatility can outpace index membership and affect passive investors.
items.summary_zh: 耐克在18年后退出标普100，伴随市值大幅下滑，引发指数成分调整。此举凸显企业价值的波动可能超越指数成分的变动，对被动投资者产生影响。

items.title_en: OpenArch – PyTorch implementations of modern LLM architectures
items.title_zh: OpenArch：现代 LLM 架构的 PyTorch 实现
items.summary_en: OpenArch provides PyTorch implementations of modern LLM architectures, enabling researchers to experiment with architectures beyond the usual suspects. It lowers the barrier to prototyping and benchmarking advanced models.
items.summary_zh: OpenArch 提供现代大模型架构的 PyTorch 实现，便于研究者试验超越常见架构的设计。降低了原型化与基准测试的门槛。

items.title_en: Data collected by cars and sold to third parties
items.title_zh: 汽车数据被收集并出售给第三方
items.summary_en: Modern cars continuously collect telemetry, location, and sensor data, much of which is sold or shared with third parties. This raises privacy concerns and highlights who controls the data and how opt-outs are handled.
items.summary_zh: 现代汽车会持续收集遥测、位置信息和传感器数据，且其中相当一部分被出售或分享给第三方。这引发隐私担忧，同时暴露了数据的控制权以及退出机制的不足。

items.title_en: Garry Tan wants US open-weight AI labs to 'distill' frontier models, too
items.title_zh: Garry Tan 希望美国公开权重的 AI 实验室也参与对前沿模型进行蒸馏
items.summary_en: Garry Tan argues that US open-weight AI labs should also distill frontier models to improve safety and accessibility, not just large incumbents. The idea envisions a more transparent, collaborative ecosystem around powerful AI.
items.summary_zh: Garry Tan 提议美国开放权重的 AI 实验室也应对前沿模型进行蒸馏，以提升安全性和可访问性，推动更为透明和协作的 AI 生态。

items.title_en: JetKVM Mini
items.title_zh: JetKVM Mini
items.summary_en: JetKVM expands its KVM-over-IP lineup with the JetKVM Mini, a compact, budget-friendly model designed for remote server management. The device promises the core KVM features in a smaller form factor, appealing to hobbyists and small teams who need remote control without bulky gear.
items.summary_zh: JetKVM 推出 JetKVM Mini，紧凑且更实惠的 KVM-over-IP 设备，面向需要远程服务器管理的个人和小团队。小巧机身保留核心功能，提供便捷的远程控制能力。

items.title_en: Things That Annoy Me About Cars
items.title_zh: 我对汽车的烦恼
items.summary_en: A candid critique of modern cars' design and usability frustrations, reflecting on how tech and interfaces shape driving experience.
items.summary_zh: 对现代汽车设计与易用性的直言不讳的批评，聚焦科技与界面对驾驶体验的影响。

items.title_en: Truncated SVD (2023)
items.title_zh: 截断的奇异值分解（2023）
items.summary_en: A practical look at truncated SVD and its modern uses in data reduction and noise handling, with tips for numeric stability and implementation. The post also discusses library choices and performance considerations.
items.summary_zh: 对截断奇异值分解及其在数据降维与降噪中的现代应用进行实用解析，附带数值稳定性与实现要点。

items.title_en: Why are AI agents lying, cheating and coordinating?
items.title_zh: 为何 AI 代理会撒谎、作弊并协同？
items.summary_en: Yoshua Bengio argues that AI agents can lie, cheat, and coordinate when pursuing reward signals in multi-agent environments. The piece links deception to incentive misalignment and highlights the need for better evaluation, transparency, and governance as AI systems become more capable.
items.summary_zh: Yoshua Bengio 指出在多代理环境中，AI 代理在追求奖励信号时可能会撒谎、作弊与协同行为。文章将这种行为与激励失配联系起来，强调在 AI 系统日益强大之际需要更好的评估、透明度与治理。

items.title_en: Ask HN: What are you working on? (September 2026)
items.title_zh: Ask HN：你在做什么？（2026年9月）
items.summary_en: A recurring monthly thread where developers share current projects, from side gigs to early-stage startups and experiments. It offers a pulse on what builders are shipping and reveals emerging technical trends.
items.summary_zh: 这是一次每月滚动的提问贴，开发者在其中分享当前项目、从副业到早期初创与实验的进展。它提供了开发者实际在部署和推出的内容的脉搏，并揭示新兴的技术趋势。

items.title_en: David Sacks: OpenAI and Anthropic Don't Need Regulations to Pace Frontier Models
items.title_zh: David Sacks：OpenAI 与 Anthropic 不需要监管就能推动前沿模型
items.summary_en: David Sacks argues that regulation isn’t necessary to pace frontier AI models, suggesting market dynamics or internal governance could suffice. His stance adds fuel to the ongoing AI governance debate.
items.summary_zh: 大卫·萨克斯认为政府监管并非加速前沿 AI 模型所必需，市场、行业自律也能推动进展，这一观点在 AI 治理辩论中具有争议性。

items.title_en: The contagion of fear
items.title_zh: 恐惧的传染性
items.summary_en: Fear can spread through media narratives and organizational chatter, driving risk aversion and overreactions. The piece argues for calmer, evidence-based communication and stronger resilience against fear-driven bias.
items.summary_zh: 恐惧通过媒体叙事和组织沟通扩散，放大风险规避和过度反应。文中倡导以证据驱动的沟通方式，以及提升对恐惧偏见的韧性。

items.title_en: SDR–; open source SDR with a patchable signal graph, Rust DSP, web UI
items.title_zh: SDR—开源 SDR，具可补丁信号图、Rust DSP、网页界面
items.summary_en: An open-source software-defined radio with a patchable signal graph, Rust DSP, and a web UI, enabling flexible signal processing workflows in the browser and on devices.
items.summary_zh: 一个开源的无线电系统，具可补丁的信号图、Rust DSP 与网页 UI，便于在浏览器和设备上构建灵活的信号处理工作流。

items.title_en: Mullenweg has returned as CEO after attempted board ouster
items.title_zh: 穆伦韦格在董事会罢黜未遂后回归 CEO
items.summary_en: Automattic founder Matt Mullenweg has resumed CEO duties after a board attempt to oust him, signaling a stabilization of governance. The move will influence product strategy across WordPress.com and related open-source initiatives, and tests how corporate governance works in a distributed, creator-led company.
items.summary_zh: Automattic 创始人 Matt Mullenweg 在董事会试图罢黜后重新担任 CEO，标志着治理局势的稳定。此举将影响 WordPress.com 等产品路线和开源计划的走向，并考验在分布式、以创作者为导向的公司中的治理实践。

items.title_en: Largest known Roman mosaic, beneath Baths of Trajan, opens to the public
items.title_zh: 图拉真浴场地下最大的罗马镶嵌画向公众开放
items.summary_en: The public opening reveals the largest known Roman mosaic unearthed beneath the Baths of Trajan, offering a vivid glimpse into imperial-era art. The find enriches the narrative around Rome’s public baths and decorative programs.
items.summary_zh: 这幅迄今发现的最大罗马镶嵌画现已向公众开放，揭示了图拉真浴场地下的帝国艺术风貌。此展览丰富了公众关于罗马浴场与装饰艺术的历史叙事。

items.title_en: One Gets Through – Missile Command, but you launch the missiles
items.title_zh: One Gets Through – Missile Command，但你发射导弹
items.summary_en: A twist on the classic Missile Command game where you play by launching missiles, offering a fresh take on a familiar arcade mechanic.
items.summary_zh: 经典街机《导弹指挥官》改编，你负责发射导弹，带来全新的玩法体验。

items.title_en: The Tudor Kings
items.title_zh: 都铎王朝与君主们
items.summary_en: An exploration of Tudor kings and their political and cultural impact, offering historical context for readers curious about early modern Britain.
items.summary_zh: 深入探讨都铎王朝君主的政治与文化影响，帮助读者理解早期现代英国的历史脉络。

items.title_en: Why is the x86 undefined instruction called ud2? Why 2?
items.title_zh: 为什么 x86 的未定义指令叫 ud2？为什么是 2？
items.summary_en: The post explains the origin of the x86 undefined instruction ud2 and clarifies why the mnemonic ends with the number 2. It uses this to illustrate broader quirks of x86 debugging conventions.
items.summary_zh: 文中追溯了 x86 未定义指令 ud2 的起源，以及为何助记符中出现数字 2。用此揭示 x86 调试习惯中的一些小古怪。

items.title_en: Open-source AI and open models reading list
items.title_zh: 开源 AI 与开源模型阅读清单
items.summary_en: A curated reading list of open-source AI projects and models, offering a spectrum of transparent, community-driven alternatives to proprietary systems. It covers licensing, safety, governance, and practical use cases for researchers and practitioners.
items.summary_zh: 这是一份关于开源 AI 项目与模型的精选阅读清单，展示了相对于专有系统的透明、社区驱动替代方案的全貌。内容涵盖许可、安全、治理以及实际应用场景。

items.title_en: Making Startups Powerful
items.title_zh: 让初创企业变得更强大
items.summary_en: Paul Graham argues that startups should focus on building leverage and durable growth to become truly powerful, not just fast iterations. The piece offers practical guidance on focus, sequencing, and scaling.
items.summary_zh: 保罗·格雷厄姆主张创业公司应追求可持续的影响力与杠杆效应，而不仅是短期扩张。文章给出创始人应关注的优先级、资源分配与扩张策略。

items.title_en: Transitions.dev: UI transitions for AI agents
items.title_zh: Transitions.dev：为 AI 代理提供 UI 动效
items.summary_en: Transitions.dev offers UI transitions designed for AI agents, improving the user experience by making agent actions feel expressive and intuitive.
items.summary_zh: Transitions.dev 提供面向 AI 代理的 UI 动效套件，提升用户交互体验，使代理行为更直观、具沉浸感。

items.title_en: LG says we're fake news [video]
items.title_zh: LG：我们是假新闻[视频]
items.summary_en: A video captures LG asserting that coverage about them is fake news, highlighting the tension between media narratives and corporate messaging online. The clip underscores the friction brands face in the digital age when dealing with press and social video.
items.summary_zh: 一段视频显示 LG 声称相关报道是假新闻，凸显媒体叙事与企业信息在网络时代的张力。该剪辑反映品牌在面对新闻报道和社交视频时所面临的博弈。

items.title_en: XCancel suspended "due to a new development in the ongoing legal proceedings"
items.title_zh: XCancel 因法律进展新发展暂停服务
items.summary_en: XCancel suspended again as new developments arise in ongoing legal proceedings. The move affects users relying on the service and underscores how legal shifts can ripple into enforcement-heavy platforms.
items.summary_zh: XCancel 因正在进行的法律程序出现新进展再度暂停服务，影响依赖该服务的用户。此举也凸显法律变动对依赖执法与拦截功能平台的影响。

items.title_en: CUDA for AMD on Windows
items.title_zh: Windows 上的 AMD CUDA 实现
items.summary_en: A community project brings CUDA-like tooling to AMD GPUs on Windows, enabling CUDA-dependent workflows to run on non-NVIDIA hardware. While not a drop-in replacement, it broadens hardware choices for ML developers and hobbyists.
items.summary_zh: 社区项目让 AMD 显卡在 Windows 上获得类似 CUDA 的体验，扩展了不能使用 NVIDIA 的硬件场景。尽管不是完全替代，但为 ML 开发者和爱好者带来更广的硬件选择。

items.title_en: The Coming War on General Computation (2011)
items.title_zh: 通用计算的来临之战
items.summary_en: A speculative piece arguing that future warfare will hinge on general-purpose computation and access to powerful compute, with implications for AI, cyber operations, and economic power.
items.summary_zh: 一篇设想性文章认为未来战争将依赖通用计算能力与强大算力，影响 AI、网络行动与经济实力。

items.title_en: The Malicious Use of Artificial Intelligence
items.title_zh: 人工智能的恶意使用
items.summary_en: This foundational risk assessment maps how AI could be misused across domains—from deception and misinformation to cybersecurity and privacy breaches—and outlines practical mitigation strategies. It emphasizes governance, red-teaming, and aligned incentives to reduce misuse risk as AI capabilities grow.
items.summary_zh: 这份基础性风险评估勾勒了人工智能在各领域的潜在滥用场景，从欺骗与错误信息扩散到网络攻击与隐私侵犯，并提出切实的缓解策略，强调治理、对抗性测试和激励对齐以降低风险。

items.title_en: Flawed routers flood University of Wisconsin internet time server (2003)
items.title_zh: 有缺陷的路由器在2003年洪泛威斯康星大学的互联网时间服务器
items.summary_en: A 2003 incident shows how flawed routing can flood critical time services, stressing the need for SNTP hardening and clean routing practices. The piece traces the misconfigurations and their impact on infrastructure.
items.summary_zh: 2003年的事件揭示了配置有误的路由器如何对关键的时间服务造成洪泛，强调 SNTP 服务器的防护和路由整洁的重要性。文中梳理了多处错误配置与对现代基础设施的教训。

items.title_en: Who Aligns the Aligners?
items.title_zh: 谁在掌控牙套的对齐？
items.summary_en: Who Aligns the Aligners? examines the players behind consumer dental aligners—regulators, manufacturers, dentists, and tech companies—and what their incentives mean for access, safety, and innovation.
items.summary_zh: 本文剖析牙套行业背后的主导者与利益相关方——监管机构、制造商、牙医和科技公司——及其对准入、安全与创新的影响。

items.title_en: An atlas of periodic solutions to the three-body problem
items.title_zh: 三体问题周期解图集
items.summary_en: An atlas of periodic solutions to the three-body problem catalogs families of periodic orbits, helping researchers navigate the rich structure of gravitational dynamics. It serves as a reference for celestial mechanics, chaos theory, and numerical exploration.
items.summary_zh: 该三体问题周期解图集按解的族群整理周期轨道，帮助研究者理解引力动力学的丰富结构。是天体力学、混沌理论和数值探索的有用参考。

items.title_en: Writing a better reality: The case for optimistic sci-fi (2022)
items.title_zh: 书写更美好的现实：乐观科幻的论证（2022）
items.summary_en: The piece argues for optimistic sci-fi as a design tool, suggesting that hopeful futures can steer real-world engineering and policy. It challenges techno-pessimism and shows how constructive narratives inspire responsible innovation and public engagement.
items.summary_zh: 本文主张以乐观科幻作为设计工具，认为对美好未来的构想可以引导现实世界的工程、治理与政策制定。它挑战技术悲观主义，展示积极叙事如何激发负责任的创新与公众参与。

items.title_en: 'Fingerprints' inside the Sun could reveal if it once swallowed a planet
items.title_zh: 太阳内部的指纹可能揭示它是否曾经吞噬过一颗行星
items.summary_en: Astronomers detect signatures inside the Sun that could record a past planetary ingestion, offering a novel way to probe solar interior dynamics and planetary formation history.
items.summary_zh: 天文学家在太阳内层发现“指纹”式信号，可能记录了曾经吞噬行星的历史。该发现为研究太阳内部结构和行星形成史提供新线索。

items.title_en: Chess.com Leak Exposes 7.3M Users, Evidence Points to Scraping
items.title_zh: Chess.com 泄露：730万用户数据曝光，证据指向抓取
items.summary_en: A data breach at Chess.com exposed about 7.3 million users, with indications that the data was scraped rather than stolen from a database. The incident highlights the privacy risks of large gaming platforms and the need for stronger API protections and rate limiting.
items.summary_zh: Chess.com 的一次数据泄露暴露约730万用户，证据指向通过数据抓取而非直接数据库被盗。事件凸显大型游戏平台的隐私风险，并呼吁加强 API 保护与访问速率限制。

items.title_en: Show HN: 1080p is 920px tall – 1k real browser viewports
items.title_zh: Show HN：1080p 实际视口高度为 920px
items.summary_en: Show HN: 1080p is 920px tall reveals real browser viewport heights vs nominal resolution, relevant for responsive design and automated testing. The finding helps developers calibrate layouts to actual device viewports.
items.summary_zh: Show HN 发布的 1080p 实际高度约为 920px 的结论，揭示实际浏览器视口高度与名义分辨率之间的差异。这对响应式设计和自动化测试的布局校准很有帮助。

items.title_en: Why is privacy so hard? (2019)
items.title_zh: 隐私为何如此难？
items.summary_en: Privacy is hard due to tangled data ecosystems, network effects, and misaligned incentives across platforms. The piece argues for privacy-by-design, pragmatic regulation, and user-centric approaches to make privacy workable.
items.summary_zh: 隐私之所以难，是因为数据生态、网络效应与平台激励错位叠加。文章主张在设计、监管与用户为中心的取向上协同，才能让隐私在现实世界中变得可行。

items.title_en: Libraries Run Rust Inside Python (With PyO3)
items.title_zh: 库在 Python 中运行 Rust（借助 PyO3）
items.summary_en: PyO3 enables calling Rust libraries from Python, unlocking near-native performance where it matters. The note covers common usage patterns, performance considerations, and potential pitfalls when mixing the two ecosystems.
items.summary_zh: PyO3 让 Rust 库能在 Python 中调用，从而在需要时获得接近原生的性能。文章讨论了常见的用法模式、性能考量以及在 Python 与 Rust 生态间引入依赖时的潜在坑点。

items.title_en: OEMpocalypse: Unprivileged Android app to root on Samsung, Xiaomi, others
items.title_zh: OEMpocalypse：未授权的 Android 应用在三星、小米等设备上获取 root 权限
items.summary_en: OEMpocalypse demonstrates an attack path where an unprivileged Android app could root devices on several manufacturers, illustrating dangerous privilege-escalation risks tied to OEM unlocking.
items.summary_zh: OEMpocalypse 展示了一个漏洞路径：未获得特权的安卓应用可能在多家厂商设备上获得 root 权限，揭示了与厂商解锁相关的高危特权提升风险。

items.title_en: “Chilling” warning or overreaction? AI bioweapons report divides experts
items.title_zh: AI 生物武器警告：冷静警示还是反应过度？
items.summary_en: The article surveys a debate on AI-driven bioweapons warnings, noting that experts disagree on urgency and feasibility. It highlights policy implications, calling for measured risk mitigation, governance, and international norms to curb misuse while preserving beneficial AI research.
items.summary_zh: 报道梳理了关于AI 驱动生物武器警示的观点分歧，指出专家在紧迫性与可行性上的分歧。强调政策含义，呼吁采取审慎的风险缓解、治理与国际规范，以防止滥用，同时保护有益的 AI 研究。

items.title_en: Reverse engineering my e-scooter and rewriting the firmware in Rust
items.title_zh: 反向工程我的电动滑板车并用 Rust 重写固件
items.summary_en: The author reverse-engineers an e-scooter, analyzes its firmware, and rewrites it in Rust for safety and reliability. The project demonstrates practical embedded Rust workflows and the benefits of Rust for firmware.
items.summary_zh: 作者对自己的电动滑板车进行了反向工程，分析固件并用 Rust 重写。项目展示了嵌入式 Rust 的实际工作流与提升安全性的可能性。

items.title_en: Spaceships (Reverse Asteroid)
items.title_zh: 太空飞船：反向小行星
items.summary_en: A creative exploration of spacecraft design in a reverse-asteroid scenario.
items.summary_zh: 这是一个关于在反向小行星情境下进行航天器设计的概念性探索。

items.title_en: TailTalk: A modern async user space AppleTalk stack with Rust and Tokio
items.title_zh: TailTalk：用 Rust 和 Tokio 构建的现代异步用户态 AppleTalk 协议栈
items.summary_en: TailTalk is a modern, asynchronous user-space AppleTalk stack built with Rust and Tokio, illustrating how to implement legacy protocols with contemporary async stacks.
items.summary_zh: TailTalk 是一个用 Rust 和 Tokio 构建的现代异步用户态 AppleTalk 协议栈，演示如何用高安全性语言实现旧有网络协议的现代化实现。

items.title_en: Julia 1.13 highlights
items.title_zh: Julia 1.13 要点解读
items.summary_en: Julia 1.13 brings notable improvements in performance, error messages, and package management, along with library updates and better cross-platform support. The release makes scientific computing in Julia more productive and scalable.
items.summary_zh: Julia 1.13 在性能、错误信息与包管理方面带来显著改进，并更新了库和跨平台支持。此版本提升了科学计算的生产力与可扩展性。

items.title_en: I added a non-wi-fi Mitsubishi AC to Home Assistant
items.title_zh: 我把一台非Wi‑Fi的三菱空调接入了 Home Assistant
items.summary_en: A maker shows how to connect a non-Wi‑Fi Mitsubishi AC to Home Assistant, enabling smart control and automations despite lack of built-in Wi‑Fi. The method demonstrates the value of local control bridges and can inspire others to retrofit legacy devices.
items.summary_zh: 博主展示如何让一台没有自带 Wi‑Fi 的三菱空调接入 Home Assistant，实现本地智能控制与自动化，降低对专属云端的依赖。

items.title_en: Reverse-Engineering Claude Web's MicroVM: Uncovering Anthropic's Hidden Antspace
items.title_zh: 逆向工程 Claude Web 的 MicroVM：揭示 Anthropic 的隐藏 Antspace
items.summary_en: Researchers reverse-engineer Claude Web's MicroVM and uncover a hidden Antspace component, shedding light on how Anthropic isolates AI workloads. The findings raise questions about security, reproducibility, and the deployment of cloud-based AI.
items.summary_zh: 研究人员对 Claude Web 的 MicroVM 进行逆向分析，发现隐藏的 Antspace 组件，揭示 Anthropic 如何对 AI 工作负载进行隔离。结果引发关于安全性、可重复性及云端 AI 部署的讨论。

items.title_en: Rope, twine and thread: Invisible technologies of the Stone Age
items.title_zh: 绳索、麻绳与线：石器时代的隐形科技
items.summary_en: Stone Age rope and fiber technologies enabled a range of practical innovations, from binding and lashings to nets and weave-based clothing. The article argues that these invisible, everyday technologies underwrote large-scale coordination and trade long before metal tools.
items.summary_zh: 石器时代的绳索与纤维技术催生了一系列实用创新，如绑缚、网具、织物等。这些看不见的日常技术推动了在金属工具出现之前就已形成的大规模协作与贸易。

items.title_en: Compressing a Flag to 11 Bits
items.title_zh: 将旗帜压缩到11位
items.summary_en: Presents a technique to encode a flag within 11 bits, exploring tight bit-level encoding and tricks often used in CTF puzzles.
items.summary_zh: 展示把旗帜信息压缩到11位的极致编码技巧，聚焦位运算与紧凑数据表示。这类方法在 CTF 等竞赛场景中常见，适合爱好者练习。

items.title_en: The GDR and Vietnam: From Fake Coffee to Coffee Empire
items.title_zh: 德意志民主共和国与越南：从假咖啡到咖啡帝国
items.summary_en: The piece traces how East Germany manipulated coffee trade with Vietnam, including fake shipments to meet quotas and extend influence, shaping Vietnam’s coffee sector amid Cold War dynamics.
items.summary_zh: 文章梳理东德在越南贸易中的“假咖啡”操控，借此达到配额与影响力扩张的目的，最终影响越南的咖啡产业，揭示商品政治与冷战格局的交织。

items.title_en: Sean Carroll explains the biggest ideas in the universe – Full Interview [video] (2025)
items.title_zh: Sean Carroll 讲解宇宙中的最大思想——完整访谈
items.summary_en: Sean Carroll breaks down the biggest ideas in cosmology in a full interview, covering entropy, spacetime, and quantum mechanics in accessible terms. The conversation clarifies how these concepts shape our understanding of reality and demonstrates the value of clear science communication.
items.summary_zh: Sean Carroll 在完整访谈中用通俗语言讲解宇宙学中的核心概念，如熵、时空与量子力学。对话帮助读者理解这些思想如何塑造对现实的认识，并凸显高效科普的重要性。

items.title_en: Base84 deserves a place in file names
items.title_zh: Base84 应该出现在文件名中
items.summary_en: The author argues for including Base84 in file-name conventions to improve cross-system robustness and metadata encoding, outlining use cases and potential trade-offs.
items.summary_zh: 作者主张在文件名中使用 Base84 编码方案，以实现跨系统的鲁棒性与一致性，同时讨论潜在的权衡与实现要点。

items.title_en: Devil's Arrows: Ancient builders hauled 55k-lb stones 11 miles for UK stone row
items.title_zh: 魔鬼之箭：古代建筑工人搬运 11 英里、5.5 万磅巨石
items.summary_en: Science Daily reports on ancient builders moving enormous stones across long distances for a stone row in the UK, shedding light on ancient engineering feats.
items.summary_zh: 科学新闻报道古代工匠搬运巨石跨越长距离建造英国石阵的史实，揭示古代工程技术的惊人水平。

items.title_en: Optimizing a Spin-Lock
items.title_zh: 优化自旋锁
items.summary_en: Details practical strategies to reduce spin-lock contention and latency, including back-off schemes and tuning for modern CPU architectures. The core takeaway is that small changes can yield measurable concurrency gains.
items.summary_zh: 介绍降低自旋锁竞争和延迟的实用策略，包括退避机制和对现代 CPU 架构的调优。核心是小改动也能带来显著的并发性能提升。

items.title_en: Trying to Make a Loop Auto-Vectorize
items.title_zh: 试图让循环自动向量化
items.summary_en: An experimental dive into making loops auto-vectorize, highlighting compiler optimizations, limitations, and practical takeaways for performance-minded developers.
items.summary_zh: 尝试让循环自动向量化的实验性研究，揭示编译器优化的边界与在追求高性能时的可用结论。

items.title_en: Bad code is kudzu
items.title_zh: 坏代码像葛藤一样蔓延
items.summary_en: Bad code spreads through systems like Kudzu, creating creeping maintenance burdens and brittle architectures. The piece advocates disciplined coding, refactoring, and architectural hygiene to curb it before it becomes unmanageable.
items.summary_zh: 坏代码像葛藤般蔓延，侵蚀系统并带来日益难以承受的维护成本与脆弱的架构。文章呼吁从编码规范、重构和架构卫生入手，防止问题蔓延。

items.title_en: Bad benchmarks and evals: Senior SWE-Bench, napkin math, and winter tires
items.title_zh: 糟糕的基准与评估：Senior SWE‑Bench、纸笔估算与冬季轮胎
items.summary_en: The post critiques common benchmarks and estimation practices in software engineering, arguing that many metrics mislead about real impact. It uses examples like 'Senior SWE-Bench' and 'napkin math' to show how sloppy numbers distort decisions and offer guidance for more robust evaluation.
items.summary_zh: 这篇博文批评了软件工程中常见的基准与估算方法，指出诸多度量会误导对真实影响的判断。通过“Senior SWE‑Bench”和“napkin math”等示例，揭示粗糙数字如何扭曲决策，并给出更严谨的评估思路。

items.title_en: Show HN: EterDB, a Postgres fork that makes it easy to recover from incidents
items.title_zh: Show HN：EterDB，一个让事故恢复更容易的 Postgres 分支
items.summary_en: EterDB is a Postgres fork designed to simplify incident recovery, enabling faster restoration to a known-good state after outages. It emphasizes features that streamline disaster recovery and reduce MTTR, appealing to teams that need reliable data resilience.
items.summary_zh: EterDB 是一个基于 Postgres 的分支，旨在简化事故恢复，在停机后更快地回滚到已知良好状态。它强调提升灾难恢复效率、降低平均修复时间，适合需要高可靠性数据韧性的团队。

items.title_en: Necker, 1832: "An optical phænomenon on viewing a figure of a geometrical solid"
items.title_zh: Necker, 1832：在观看几何固体图形时的光学现象
items.summary_en: An 1832 note discusses an optical phenomenon observed when viewing a geometric solid, illustrating early concerns about perspective and perception. It sheds light on the long history of cognitive science and visual reasoning.
items.summary_zh: 1832年的一篇笔记讨论在观看几何立体图形时观察到的光学现象，揭示了早期对透视与知觉的关注，对认知科学和视觉推理的历史有所启发。

items.title_en: The Nature of Dance
items.title_zh: 舞蹈的本质
items.summary_en: The Nature of Dance examines how movement embodies natural principles, blending science with aesthetics to illuminate why dance resonates across cultures.
items.summary_zh: 《舞蹈的自然》从运动如何映射自然规律入手，将科学与美学结合，揭示舞蹈为何在不同文化中广受共鸣的原因。

items.title_en: Show HN: Apollo Lunar Module landing simulation
items.title_zh: Show HN：阿波罗登月舱着陆仿真
items.summary_en: Show HN introduces a landing simulation for the Apollo Lunar Module, illustrating descent physics under lunar gravity. The project offers a sandbox to experiment with guidance algorithms, thruster control, and an interface for semi-autonomous landings. It invites community feedback on realism and potential enhancements.
items.summary_zh: Show HN 推出一个阿波罗登月舱着陆仿真，展示在月球引力下的下降物理。该项目提供一个试验场，用于探究制导算法、喷推控制和半自主着陆的界面设计，并欢迎社区就真实感与改进点提供反馈。
